shape: 2-portal sprawling arena (N + E gates) with center super-hub + NW chain + SW chain
description: Two-portal arena with a south super-hub (w0klx6 at (7.26, -6.66), 5-way) that joins south clique (nypojq + west to ey4l82 + spawn_north chain). A center anchor (nypojq) is a 4-way hub joining the east arc (9xhw22 → spawn_east + auo4nh) and the southern flow. NW cluster: k76oxk → iizgnl + 9btp3u + 3hb6ct. SW cluster off w0klx6: ey4l82 → spawn_north via gf0b6j, plus mo31a4 + w701ia.

portals.north: spawn_north at (-7.52, -23.20) — gate on the north (low-Z) side
portals.east: spawn_east at (23.62, 9.48) — gate on the east (high-X) side

traversalNotes: Direct N→E: spawn_north → n_inner → south_hub → south_c → east_inner → spawn_east. 5 hops.
Alt N→E via south_c: spawn_north → n_inner → south_hub → south_c → n_center → east_inner. 6 hops.
DISPATCH RULE: south_hub (w0klx6) is the south 5-way dispatcher; south_c (nypojq) is the south-center 4-way; east_inner is the east 4-way.
NW CLUSTER (n_center → nw_center → nw_pocket + nw_west) is a 3-anchor west chain accessible from n_center.
ne_step and ne_inner are detour pockets.
